title: Remove Instagram's login popup
question: How do I view Instagram without the login popup?
answer: Instagram has no setting to stop the sign-up popup for logged-out visitors, but on profile pages the popup has a Close (X) button. The usermods script on this page clicks that button for you as soon as the popup appears, so the profile, its posts and the page scrolling come back without a click. It leaves Instagram's other dialogs alone. Without an extension, click the X in the popup's top right corner each time it shows up.
prompt: On Instagram, close the sign up / log in popup automatically when I'm not logged in so I can scroll the profile.
details:
While the popup is open, Instagram freezes the page behind it. Hiding the popup with CSS would leave a page that cannot scroll, so the script clicks Instagram's own Close button instead and lets Instagram unfreeze the page.

The script finds the popup by the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy links inside it, and the Close button by its `aria-label="Close"`. That label is in English, so the script needs Instagram's English interface.

Limits:

- Logged out, Instagram shows only the first dozen or so posts of a profile and asks you to log in for more. The script does not change that.
- Popups that have no Close button, such as the one some post links show, stay. The check covers profile pages only.

alternatives.title: Close it by hand
alternatives.body: Click the **X** at the top right of the popup. Instagram unfreezes the page, and the profile scrolls normally until you reload.

evidence.note: Browse Instagram Without Logging In (Removes login/register Pop-up and opens up links) (total installs: 7458)
suggestions: instagram without login | instagram without login open | instagram without login reels | instagram without login viewer | instagram without login website

check.expect: (() => { const popups = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role="dialog"]')].filter((d) => d.querySelector('a[href*="privacycenter.instagram.com/policy"]') && d.checkVisibility()); return popups.length === 0 && !document.querySelector('#scrollview[aria-hidden="true"]') && document.documentElement.scrollHeight > innerHeight + 500; })()
